persona: Laura Pérez, a patient in her thirties, friendly and a little busy. You live in Madrid.
goal: Book a check-up and cleaning for next Tuesday ({{say:next tuesday}}) at three in the afternoon. In your first reply, say you do not need a text reminder. Once the agent has the booking done, change your mind: you do want the reminder.

facts.phone number: +34 612 345 678 (say it as: plus three four, six one two, three four five, six seven eight)
facts.reminder: you first say you do not need one, then change your mind: you do want one

moves: Open by saying you'd like to book a check-up and cleaning next Tuesday at three in the afternoon, and that you do not need a text reminder.
Give your phone number when asked and confirm read-backs that are right. Do not mention the reminder again.

As soon as the agent says the team will confirm the booking by text, that it has noted you want no reminder, or asks you about a reminder, say: actually, scrap that, I do want the text reminder after all. Thanks, goodbye. Hang up in that same reply.
judge_notes: The caller first declined the reminder, then corrected it to yes before its step finished and hung up. The reminder must be saved as yes; no (the answer they corrected) is a wrong save, also when it is made at the call's end.
